Turnaround Story: 8 stocks shift from loss to profit in September '26 quarter
Written by
Ritesh Presswala
, ETMarkets.com|
Oct 31, 2026, 02:23:21 PM IST
1/9
​Turnaround Story
A "Turnaround Story YoY" indicates that a company has moved from reporting a net loss in the corresponding quarter last year to posting a net profit in the latest quarter, signalling a significant improvement in its financial performance. Within the Nifty 500 universe, we have highlighted eight stocks that reported a return to profitability in the September 2026 quarter, compared with losses in the year-ago quarter, based on StockEdge's profitability scan data.
ETMarkets.com
2/9
Aditya Birla Real Estate
The company reported a net profit of Rs 859 crore in the September 2026 quarter, compared with a net loss of Rs 16 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.
ETMarkets.com

The firm posted a net profit of Rs 71 crore in the September 2026 quarter, against a net loss of Rs 10 crore in the year-ago quarter.

IndusInd Bank
The lender reported a net profit of Rs 1,242 crore in the September 2026 quarter, compared with a net loss of Rs 437 crore in the same quarter last year.

Bharat Coking Coal posted a net profit of Rs 124 crore in the September 2026 quarter, against a net loss of Rs 53 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.
